items.gist: Prescribes doubled lakṣa japa for naimittika rites and guru worship after dīkṣā and abhiṣeka.
Describes selecting the qualified guru, preparing the maṇḍala and seat, and worshipping him with mantras, offerings, and dakṣiṇā.
Explains that satisfying the guru through dakṣiṇā grants adhikāra, while neglecting guru worship brings repeated births.
After guru worship, the disciple worships the cakra according to capacity; guru worship remains essential, and this is classified as naimittika karma.
